answer_1.quote: We fine-tune a left-to-right language model GPT2 to perform response generation given the dialog context x and the chosen knowledge snippet ŝ ...

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation of responses, we use ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L metrics. ... we only report perplexity scores when using gold-standard knowledge, as a measure for the quality of the response generator alone.

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 200 turns from the output of MIKe, our ranking model and our graph-based model. Annotators are asked to select which system's response is the best among the three (allowing for ties), and which system's knowledge is the most relevant. In addition, annotators score each response based on whether it is appropriate, knowledgeable and engaging on a scale of 1-4.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose the best response and rate each response on appropriateness, knowledgeability, and engagement.
